summary: Calavo Growers filed an 8-K disclosing the expiration of the HSR Act waiting period for its acquisition by Mission Produce under a two-step merger. Terms of the deal were not restated in this filing but were previously disclosed in the Merger Agreement dated January 14, 2026. The closing remains subject to shareholder approvals from both Calavo and Mission Produce, as well as clearance from Mexican antitrust authorities. The parties expect to close the transaction in the fiscal quarter ending July 31, 2026. Key watch items include receipt of shareholder votes and the Mexico antitrust approval timeline.
